metadata.timingScope: Warm local e5-small inference included; first-use lexical term cache; no MCP/network/excerpt rendering; JEV includes RRF shared first stage. No query embedding cache.

dataQuality.graphIntegration: 명시적으로 확인된 상위 규정에서 하위 시행세칙/내규 방향만 가점. 상향/일반 인용/방향 불명은 가점하지 않음.

model.scope: Experimental; fitted on all 71 public questions, not independently evaluated. No production activation.
